name: Insulin and Syringes
description: Guidelines for traveling with insulin and syringes in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Insulin (liquid) and syringes are permitted. Syringes are allowed in carry-on bags when accompanied by insulin or other injectable medications.
conditions: Declare your syringes and insulin to the TSA officer before screening.
Keep used needles in an approved disposal container if checked.

faq.question: Is insulin and syringes allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Insulin and Syringes is allowed in carry-on luggage. Insulin (liquid) and syringes are permitted. Syringes are allowed in carry-on bags when accompanied by insulin or other injectable medications.

faq.question: Can you pack insulin and syringes in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Insulin and Syringes is allowed in checked bags.
